note: An incomplete fix of GHSA-xq3w-v528-46rv. The /proc/sys/net/core/somaxconn read runs in NetUtil$SoMaxConnAction.run (4.1.100 on) or the anonymous NetUtil$1.run (4.1.0); later NetUtil$1 classes have no run, so listing both does no harm. Exploitable on Windows only. NetUtil's static init runs the action, so most Netty services reach it.
